fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.description: The quoted sentence itself, without surrounding quotation marks — the block draws those.

fields.name: attribution
fields.label: Attribution
fields.description: Who or what is being quoted. A person's name, or a source for a statistic. Leave empty for an unattributed pull quote.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role or organisation
fields.description: Optional second line, e.g. "Head of Benefits, New York Life". Deliberately NOT named attributionTitle: a *Title suffix is read as a companion of `attribution` (the link-title convention), which would put two independent text values in one cell and fail the import.
